heading: Comprehensive Test Management
description: Effortlessly monitor and manage all assessments with a comprehensive view of ongoing, upcoming, and past exams. Gain easy access to each test's details, schedule, and status, ensuring organized oversight of the entire testing process from start to finish.

examination.title: Examination
examination.description: A Fixed-time assessment that goes live for a specific schedule, simulating real exam conditions.

mock.title: Mock Assessment
mock.description: A practice assessment always available, with a fixed duration to replicate exam scenarios.

practice.title: Practice Assessment
practice.description: An on-demand assessment with no time limits, allowing students to attempt it anytime.

survey.title: Survey
survey.description: A set of questions for feedback or opinions, with no right or wrong answers.

manualUploadExam.title: Written Paper (Copy Check)
manualUploadExam.description: Upload the question paper (and the answer key / marking scheme). Students solve on paper and upload their copies; the AI or a teacher checks them.

bestFor.examination: Class tests, term exams and finals everyone takes together
bestFor.mock: Full-length exam rehearsal students can retake anytime
bestFor.practice: Homework and self-paced revision, retake anytime
bestFor.manualUploadExam: Board-style papers checked from students’ answer copies

typePicker.paperFlow: Upload the paper, students upload their copies, then AI or a teacher checks them
typePicker.notSure: Not sure? Use Examination for a test the whole class takes at one time, and Practice for homework.
